# Auric Vow — Art Review Work Order

## Verdict
**FAIL** (5/5 critics failed; average score **24.8/100**). Most damaging: the first-person weapon viewmodel is still authored in camera space and drawn over the third-person camera, so two near-plane slabs occlude 25–35% of **every** captured frame — all five critics led with it.

## Blind test summary
All five critics said Warframe wins instantly, and none called it close. Recurring tells: the viewmodel slabs read as a broken build; the level has no cast shadows and no true blacks, so it reads as an untextured greybox with an ivory tint; gold shows no specular ramp; every VFX is one flat additive primitive smeared by bloom; no legible enemy exists in 21 frames. Harshest (ui-readability): *"These frames read as an untextured greybox with a bloom filter and a web-app toast notification in the corner. 12_ability_volley is a flat orange rectangle with a rounded-rect chip floating on it; no shipped game would let that frame out of a capture session."*

## Work order

### environment-art
1. **[BLOCKER]** Turn on architecture shadow casting: add `castShadow` to every rib instance (RIB_CANYON/CHAMBER/ARENA/BRIDGE), `B_WALL_PANELS`, pylons and mega-body in `ShrineStation.tsx`. Then replace the single 110×110 ortho directional in `Lighting.tsx` with 3-cascade CSM (or a camera-recentred −25..25 ortho plus the wide one for distant blockers), retuning bias to ~−0.0002 with normalBias 0.02.
2. **[BLOCKER]** Add ambient occlusion: N8AO/GTAO as the first pass in `PostFX.tsx` before Bloom (radius 0.6 m, falloff 1.0, intensity 2.0, halfRes, gated off at qualityTier ≥ 1), plus a baked vertex-AO darkening on the bottom 0.3 m of instanced ribs and panels so contact shadows survive on low tier.
3. **[BLOCKER]** Rebuild the value structure: in `materials.ts` pull ivory albedo to ~#C4BCAC, add a tiling normal map (panel seams, chamfers, Orokin fret) and a cavity/AO map from `textures.ts`, plus a separate near-black recess material for every panel gap and joint. In `config.ts`, drop exposure 1.15→0.85, hemisphere 0.7→0.32, cameraFill 0.55→0.25, and delete or halve the coolRim so the 2.2 key does the modelling; target a populated 0.25–0.65 histogram band.
4. **[BLOCKER]** Add ornamental density: build a reusable `<OrokinTrim>` (stepped `THREE.Shape` + ExtrudeGeometry) run along every arch and column joint, swap plain column cylinders for fluted LatheGeometry profiles, and instance filigree/glyph decal bands from `getGlyphSpriteTexture()`. Keep it inside the 316-geometry budget via InstancedMesh.
5. **[BLOCKER]** Make gold read as metal: raise `MATERIALS.envMapResolution` 256→512, add a narrow intensity-6 white strip Lightformer above/behind plus a near-black ground Lightformer and warm horizon band, then split `goldMaterial()` into goldPolished (rough 0.14) and goldCast (0.38) with an anisotropic brushed-streak roughness map so highlights break up.
6. **[MAJOR]** Discipline the palette: inset every cyan strip into a recessed channel with a dark surround and gradient end falloff, cut cyan element count by at least half, and add a deep umber value in `COLORS` for panel recesses and floor bands so gold has somewhere to sit.
7. **[MAJOR]** Make the teal practicals light something: derive light positions from `layout.ts` vein placement instead of the hardcoded `TEAL_POINTS`, offset 0.3 m along the surface normal, retune to intensity 6 / distance 6 / decay 2, and cap to the nearest 4 by camera distance. Same for gold veins in EnvironmentFX.
8. **[MAJOR]** Rebuild the title screen: dedicated title camera in `src/screens` composing a three-quarter hero shot against clean sky with architecture as a dark framing mass, viewmodel suppressed, a gradient scrim reserving a quiet band for the wordmark, and a layered plate/bevel/filigree treatment replacing glow-on-serif — subtitle demoted to ash, control hints to one low-opacity base line.
9. **[MAJOR]** Upgrade the skybox in `Skybox.tsx`: ShaderMaterial planet with Fresnel limb glow, smoothstepped terminator derived from the `LIGHTING.key` vector so it agrees with the level, procedural band noise, rings as a mip-filtered textured disc with a shadow band, and two parallax star/nebula planes.
10. **[MINOR]** Add sky contribution to the environment map: wide low-intensity Lightformers matching `FOG.skyHorizon` on −Z and skyZenith above, so ivory and gold pick up a cool upper-face tint and foreground matches backdrop.

### player-frame
1. **[BLOCKER]** Kill the camera-space viewmodel. Gate `<WeaponViewModel/>` on an actual first-person mode; in third person, re-author the rifle around a grip origin at (0,0,0) with the barrel along −Z, parent it as a real child of `PlayerSockets.rightHand` and the sheath as a child of the hip group (drop the `parent.worldToLocal` conversion and the `addScaledVector(_aimDir, 0.12)` push), at world scale (~0.9 m rifle, ~0.95 m katana). Delete the camera-copy fallback branch entirely, derive `MuzzleWorld` from the socket matrix, and add a cull when the socket is within camera.near + 0.5 m.
2. **[BLOCKER]** Fix the stuck cruciform pose in `PlayerRig.tsx`: delete the air-apex branch that hard-assigns shLz/shRz, blend ascend/fall poses by v.y instead, gate the whole air block behind `state === 'air' && crouch < 0.1`, fix the ground probe in `PlayerController.tsx` so the spawn dais and chamber floor report grounded, and add an asymmetric idle with weight shift and 0.4 Hz breath.
3. **[BLOCKER]** Stop the ultimate camera clipping into the body: raise `cam.boomMin` from 0.5 to ≥1.2 (above the 0.54 m shoulder span), add a dither/opacity fade on rig materials below ~1.5 m boom distance, and give the ultimate its own camera state that pushes the boom to ~6 m and drops ~1 m so the frame silhouettes against the nova.
4. **[BLOCKER]** Rebuild the silhouette: layered asymmetric shoulder plates, tapered chest with raised crest, thigh/knee/greave shells at ≥25% limb diameter (delete the 8–16 mm tori and ridge boxes — nothing under 0.04 m carries read), a gauntlet with wrist pivot and wrapped finger volume replacing the hand boxes, an ankle pivot with a wedge boot replacing the ivory bricks, and an armoured collar/gorget filling the head-to-shoulder void.
5. **[BLOCKER]** Author the back at parity with the front — it is 100% of the gameplay read. Mirror the `makeShellPlate()` shells to z ≈ −0.05, add an extruded gold spine keel, scapular pauldron backs and a segmented rear waist skirt.
6. **[MAJOR]** Fix proportions: helmet scale −25% (head ≈0.22 m on 1.8 m), head group to [0,0.74,0] with a short armoured neck, shoulders ±0.27→±0.33 with pauldron span ~0.68 m, legs ±0.13→±0.18; re-check every emissive against the new pivots.
7. **[MAJOR]** Light and texture the character: replace the single `playerRim` with a cool #BFE8FF and warm #FFB835 pair on the player layer (distance 4, decay 2, intensity 9), raise obsidian albedo to ~#24282F, split plate roughness (0.30 body / 0.12 trim / 0.55 undersuit), and apply `textures.ts` generators for panel-line roughness, curvature edge wear on gold, AO on ivory plates. Give the viewmodel its own layer-2 spot + fill rig and drop its metalness to 0.35.
8. **[MAJOR]** Add head look-at: spring-damped yaw from camera-vs-root delta clamped ±0.6 rad and pitch ±0.5 rad, head spring stiffness ~200 vs torso 120 so the head leads the turn by ~80 ms, plus a ±0.25 rad chest counter-twist.
9. **[MAJOR]** Fix the scarf: MeshStandardMaterial DoubleSide with emissive confined to the last 3–4 segments, break the mirror (ribbon[1] segment length ×1.18, different gravity/drag, Z-offset anchor), gravity 2→6 and drag 0.85→0.7, width 0.07→0.14 tapering to 0.04, with velocity-driven per-segment twist.
10. **[MAJOR]** Replace the capsule+sphere dash ghosts with clones of the real rig subtree (3–5 pooled, additive aureate override), storing full pose — torso, shoulders, elbows, hips, knees — in the history sampler, and clamp ghost additive intensity so it stops clipping the frame to white.

### combat-feel
1. **[BLOCKER]** Fix the capture harness before any re-review: 08/09/10/11/12 are aimed at empty sky. Use `window.__qa.enemyPositions()` and `lookAt()` to place the player ~12 m from the nearest alive trooper and heavy at chest height, then advance the fixed-dt clock so tracers and impacts are mid-flight at shutter time.
2. **[BLOCKER]** Make transient VFX survive a 33 ms step: give muzzle flash and impacts a minimum lifetime of ~0.08 s, and audit `Weapons.tsx`/`Flashes.tsx` to confirm quads actually spawn and persist.
3. **[BLOCKER]** Restore hit feedback: `.dmg` 15→22 px and headshot/ability 20→34 px with a 2 px dark outline via `paint-order: stroke`, a 1.35→1.0 scale punch over 120 ms, a rebuilt hitmarker of four 3×14 px chevrons expanding 6→18 px over 130 ms (white body / aureate crit / 8-tick ring on kill), and a 60 ms 6% radial white vignette flash on crit.
4. **[BLOCKER]** Fix tracers in `Weapons.tsx`: they die at 36 m of a 120 m range. Set `t.life = t.dist / TRACER_SPEED + 0.06`, retire only on `tail >= dist`, drop speed to ~180 m/s, raise TRACER_SEG to ~14 m, taper the core (CylinderGeometry(0.2,1,1)) and ramp halo opacity along the tail. Billboard the halo and clamp its width in screen space so it stays ≥~6 px at range.
5. **[MAJOR]** Give firing a light and a terminator: pooled 2-frame muzzle PointLight (#FFE9C4, intensity 25, distance 7) on the viewmodel and world layers, a 3-frame randomly-rolled star sprite with a white-hot inner quad, and on every shot either a hit branch (scorch decal, 6–10 velocity-aligned stretched sparks, 1-frame intensity-8 impact light) or an explicit miss branch with a 0.1 s puff at max range.
6. **[MAJOR]** Fix the katana: convert the tip with `g.worldToLocal(_tip)` before `hand.lookAt` (the root's `rotateY(PI)` currently aims the blade backwards), then sample bladeTipWorld() at ~16 points into a triangle strip from guard radius to tip, white leading edge fading to aureate over 0.18 s, with velocity-aligned sparks at each intersection.
7. **[MAJOR]** Add landing weight: on isGrounded false→true, drive a ~0.22 s absorb from impact velocity (bodyY −0.35 m, knees +1.3 rad, torso pitch +0.3 rad) recovering on the existing springs, emit a matching downward camera boom offset and ground puff, and drive a small periodic camera settle from the gait phase.
8. **[MAJOR]** Fix the reticle: render as SVG with a 1 px near-black stroke around vellum fill so it holds against both purple sky and ivory walls, correct the asymmetric `.t-n/.t-s` offsets to `calc(4.5px + var(--spread))` from the dot edge, and animate spread — bloom on fire, snap on aim, ~90 ms.
9. **[MINOR]** Make casings register: eject from the receiver's world position with ~1.5 m/s lateral impulse plus tumble, 1.2 s life, metalness ~0.9 so the new muzzle light glints off them; verify they clear the rescaled weapon volume.

### vfx-postfx
1. **[BLOCKER]** Reclaim the bloom threshold: raise `POSTFX.bloom.luminanceThreshold` 0.7→1.0 and intensity 1.25→0.9 so lit ivory stops blooming, and raise `MATERIALS.emissiveBoost` to ~3.0 for actual energy materials (veinTeal, veinGold, medallion, doorGlow, seal) so only they cross. Verify with a luminance-threshold debug view: only emissive geometry may survive.
2. **[BLOCKER]** Fix chromatic aberration: cap `spikeOffset` 0.004→~0.0015 (BASE_CA 0.0002), enable `radialModulation` with modulationOffset ~0.15–0.35 so screen centre stays clean, drive it from a dedicated `caImpulseAt` timestamp on a ~0.12 s ease-out instead of `timeScale < 1`, and composite the HUD outside the EffectComposer output.
3. **[BLOCKER]** Build a shared three-layer energy shell helper in `src/game/vfx/` and use it for the nova, halo, javelins and katana arc: white-hot core (#FFF3D6, boost 4.0), saturated additive mid (#FFB835, boost 1.6–1.8, 1.25×), wide soft outer falloff sprite (opacity ~0.22, 3×), plus a pooled PointLight (max 6 live) per instance so effects actually relight the architecture and the player's plates.
4. **[BLOCKER]** Make the ultimate a light event: pooled PointLight at the nova origin, #FFF3D6, distance 28, intensity keyframed 0→450→0 over the 1.2 s window, with three nested rings (radial gradient across the ring width, plus a counter-rotating torus at 0.85× radius / 0.4× opacity) and a radial spark burst replacing the single constant-width white circle.
5. **[BLOCKER]** Fix Sunspike Volley: `javelinAnchor()` places javelins 0.35 m *behind* the player — change to `addScaledVector(_dir, 1.6)` forward, widen lateral spread 0.28→~0.45 per index, give each javelin a tapered core plus 3× outer shell, a trail ribbon and a low-intensity flash, and clamp the windup emissive so the frame stops washing to flat orange. Seven javelins must be countable.
6. **[MAJOR]** Rebuild Aegis Halo as a shell, not a circle: sphere around the player with `pow(1.0 - abs(dot(N,V)), 3.0) * 0.55` additive fresnel, scrolling Orokin glyph texture, a ground-contact ellipse at the shell radius, and a width-wise colour ramp from aureate outer to solarWhite inner kept below the bloom clipping point.
7. **[MAJOR]** Fix ejecta and debris: re-tint the requiem's cyan/mint quads to the aureate/solarWhite palette, orient each along its velocity vector with length scaled by speed so they streak, and replace flat stick/square debris with soft additive sprites.
8. **[MAJOR]** Add per-vertex alpha ramps to `Trails.tsx` — 1 at the spine to 0 at both edges, 1 at head to 0 at tail — so dash and sprint trails stop reading as hard-edged flat white wedges.
9. **[MAJOR]** Layer the character's emissive: split `mats.glow` into core (solarWhite ~4×, thin), mid (aureate ~2×) and a wider additive falloff shell at ~0.4 opacity depthWrite false, nested per element, plus 2–3 small point lights at chest, spine and hip so the frame is lit by its own energy.
10. **[MINOR]** Give the sun lens character: add a screen-space flare (streak quad plus 2–3 ghosts) driven from the sun's projected position, gated off at qualityTier 2 alongside the existing Bloom/SMAA gating.

### enemies-hud
1. **[BLOCKER]** Make enemies exist on screen: tighten the spawn ring toward the player in `EnemyManager.tsx`, raise Trooper/Heavy silhouette mass (broader shoulder and helmet volumes), give hostiles a dark base plus an accent colour used nowhere in the level palette (desaturated crimson/violet), a fresnel rim term `pow(1.0 - dot(N,V), 3.0)`, and an inverted-hull outline at 2–3 px screen width beyond 15 m.
2. **[BLOCKER]** Add threat information: a ~140 px diegetic gold-ringed radar in the top-left plotting enemies within 40 m as yaw-oriented chevrons off the same list that feeds `.wc-alive`, plus edge-of-screen threat chevrons for enemies currently firing, reusing the `proj.copy(world).project(cam)` projection in `DamageNumbers.tsx` clamped to the border when `proj.z > 1`.
3. **[MAJOR]** Replace the generic web-UI vocabulary in `hud.css`: clip-path chamfers, diamonds and chevrons instead of border-radius, 1 px gold hairline rules, near-transparent fills, and inline-SVG plates for the chips. Merge the objective toast into the top-centre wave chip (objective verb line one, wave pips and hostile count line two, distance as a right-aligned tabular field with a hairline divider), and animate state change — 250 ms slide plus gold flash on objective update, pip fill on wave completion.
4. **[MAJOR]** Fix the vitals cluster: HP bar 14→20 px, shield 8→12 px, separated by a 3 px gap and a 1 px gold rule, with shield and vitae glyphs at the left caps. Move `.bar-num` off the gradient fill (or set it to deep-relic with a light halo where it overlaps) and verify 4.5:1 against both empty and full bar states.
5. **[MAJOR]** Invert the hierarchy back: ammo 28→18 px, drop the heavy `.ammo-box` border, delete the `/ ∞` reserve, and spend that weight on a 20 px numeric energy readout beside the ability tray. Squint-test at 25%: HP and energy must resolve, ammo must not.
6. **[MAJOR]** Regroup the anchors: move `.combat` (abilities + energy) into the lower-left so vitals, energy and the tray form one contiguous L-cluster with energy directly above the diamonds it funds; leave only ammo/weapon bottom-right. Four anchors down to three.
7. **[MAJOR]** Make the ability tray legible: `.ab-key`/`.ab-cost` 10→13 px, weight 700, tabular numerals, cost moved onto a chamfered tab below the diamond; redraw the four glyphs as inline SVG on a shared 24×24 grid with 2 px strokes and one silhouette idea each (chevron trail, spear fan, closed ring, filled starburst); unaffordable state = 35% opacity desaturated face, not a 10 px red number; animate the cooldown sweep with a bright leading edge and a 150 ms flash-to-white on completion.
8. **[MINOR]** Rebuild the channel indicator as a real arc: SVG ring with 4 px stroke driven by `stroke-dashoffset`, 25% tick marks, a bright leading-edge dot, a 16 px tabular readout inside, a dark backing plate behind the label, framed in the shared chamfered plate and anchored to the Reliquary in world space with a leader line.

# AURIC VOW — Visual Overhaul Technical Map

Repo root: `/home/user/-/auric-vow`. All paths below are repo-relative.

## Architecture — how a frame is built

`src/App.tsx` routes title/game/pause/win/lose and mounts `src/game/GameCanvas.tsx` unconditionally (the sim runs behind every overlay). The `<Canvas>` sets the renderer contract: `ACESFilmicToneMapping`, exposure 1.15, `antialias:false`, `PCFSoftShadowMap`, `dpr [1,2]`, fov 70 / near 0.1 / far 400 — tonemapping is injected into every material, so the composer only ever sees LDR.

Mount order inside the Canvas: **Skybox → Fog → Lighting → ShrineStation → EnvironmentFX → ColliderDebug → PlayerController/PlayerRig/CameraRig → CombatSystems + WeaponViewModel → EnemyManager → MissionDirector/ObjectiveMarker → VFXSystems → QualityWatcher/IntroSkipper/GameTick → PostFX** (last, takes over the render loop).

Frame ordering is by `useFrame` priority, not mount order: PlayerController (-10) → PlayerRig (-9) → CameraRig (-8) → everything else (0). Cross-system state is mutable module singletons, never React: `PlayerRef`/`PlayerAnim`, `CamRef`, `CombatState`, `MuzzleWorld`, `EnemyRegistry`, `SpawnStatus`, `abilityState`/`ammoState`/`enemyState`, plus four VFX command queues. Two extra `requestAnimationFrame` loops (`HUD.tsx`, `DamageNumbers.tsx`) run outside R3F entirely.

Ownership: `world/layout.ts` owns all coordinates (art *and* collision read it); `world/materials.ts` owns material singletons that `EnvironmentFX` mutates in place; `vfx/VFXBus.ts` is the only VFX vocabulary (burst/ring/flash/trail — one consumer per queue); `combat/DamageSystem.ts` is the single damage funnel; `MissionDirector` is the sole phase authority.

## Subsystem map

**Environment** — `world/ShrineStation.tsx` (whole level; `Instanced`/`MassMesh` helpers, zones A–E), `world/layout.ts` (coords + `buildLevelColliders`), `world/materials.ts` (singletons, `boosted()`), `world/Lighting.tsx` (`TEAL_POINTS`, `GOD_RAYS`, `CameraFill`, `DustField`), `world/Skybox.tsx`, `world/Fog.tsx`, `world/EnvironmentFX.tsx`. Safe change: placement → `layout.ts`; look → `materials.ts`; rig → the two Lighting tables; anything animated → `EnvironmentFX`. Never fork a material — they are shared by reference.

**Player** — `player/PlayerRef.ts` (contract), `player/PlayerController.tsx` (FSM + capsule), `player/PlayerRig.tsx` (57 meshes, `Spring`, `Ribbon`, ghosts), `player/CameraRig.tsx` (`CamRef`, `addTrauma`), `player/movementConfig.ts` (`MOVE`/`ANIM`). Safe change: pose targets and `ANIM` constants; the rig reads `PlayerAnim` only — never write gameplay state from it.

**Combat** — `combat/Weapons.tsx` (tracer/GunFx pools, `bladeTipWorld`, `getMuzzleWorld`), `combat/Abilities.tsx` (A1–A4 + `RequiemFx` shaders), `combat/ViewModel.tsx`, `combat/DamageSystem.ts`, `combat/state.ts` (`combatTick` scales all timers by `timeScale`). Safe change: feedback fan-out lives in `fireShot`/`resolveSwing`/`resolveEnemyHit`; add visuals there, not in the FSMs.

**VFX/PostFX** — `vfx/VFXBus.ts` (four verbs, hard caps 256/32/32/512, count ≤120), `vfx/Particles.tsx`, `vfx/Trails.tsx`, `vfx/Shockwaves.tsx`, `vfx/Flashes.tsx`, `vfx/Ambient.tsx`, `PostFX.tsx`. Safe change: new primitives must be added to the bus *and* given exactly one consumer; renderOrder band is 18–22.

**Enemies/Mission/HUD** — `enemies/EnemyRegistry.ts` (hp/stagger/DEATH_FX), `enemies/{Trooper,Drone,Heavy}.tsx` (self-contained FSM + procedural mesh), `enemies/EnemyManager.tsx` (spawn director), `enemies/ai.ts`, `enemies/dissolve.ts`, `mission/MissionDirector.tsx`, `mission/zones.ts`, `hud/HUD.tsx` + `hud/hud.css`, `screens/*`. Safe change: HUD is DOM-only, written by direct style mutation in one rAF — add elements to the skeleton, drive them in `tick()`.

## Weakness register

| id | area | file | what is wrong | Warframe gap | sev |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | combat | `src/game/combat/Weapons.tsx` | `CamRef.pitch += 0.008`/shot, never recovered; `cs.recoil` is a static offset | shaped kick + spring-back recentre | blocker |
| C2 | combat | `src/game/combat/Weapons.tsx` | No swept arc mesh; swing "crescent" is a flat XZ ring at chest height | authored per-combo blade-plane arcs | blocker |
| C3 | combat | `src/game/combat/Weapons.tsx` | Impact FX fire at trace time; tracer dies at ~36 m (life 0.09 s, 400 m/s) | FX scheduled at bolt arrival | blocker |
| C4 | combat | `src/game/combat/ViewModel.tsx` | No reload animation; `cs.reloading` never read (1.4 s frozen pose) | full mag-drop reload per weapon | blocker |
| C5 | combat | `src/game/combat/Abilities.tsx` | Requiem's 8 pillars are bare `plane(3,22)`, yawed not billboarded, hard-cut ends | soft gradient shafts + ground caustic | blocker |
| N1 | enemies | `src/game/enemies/Trooper.tsx` | `rush` true whenever ≥3 alive → band-strafe, burst fire and eye telegraph are dead code | legible ranged behaviour and tells | blocker |
| N2 | enemies | `src/game/enemies/Trooper.tsx` | Melee damages on proximity with no windup, swing, flare or sound | full wind-up animation per attack | blocker |
| N3 | enemies | `src/game/enemies/Trooper.tsx` | Rigid tip-over death; Heavy torso lerps 0.7 m through its sibling leg groups | ragdoll with killing-blow impulse | blocker |
| N4 | enemies | `src/game/enemies/dissolve.ts` | Only the colour material is patched — dissolving corpses cast whole solid shadows | shadow follows the dissolve mask | blocker |
| E1 | env | `src/game/world/ShrineStation.tsx` | Zero environment `castShadow`, zero `receiveShadow` on the player, no aoMap, no SSAO pass | shadow + cavity AO carry the read | blocker |
| E2 | env | `src/game/world/ShrineStation.tsx` | `RBOX` scaled non-uniformly → 0.03–4.75 m fillets; trim uses sharp `BOX` | fixed 1–3 cm machined bevel | blocker |
| E3 | env | `src/game/world/ShrineStation.tsx` | Glyph "decals" float 0.65–5 m off walls; corruption veins miss their ribs by 3 m | projected decals + geometry growth | blocker |
| E4 | env | `src/game/world/Lighting.tsx` | 6 `TEAL_POINTS` have no fixture, sit 5–12 m from their strips, don't pulse with them | modelled emissive fixtures, locked animation | blocker |
| E5 | env | `src/game/world/materials.ts` | All glow is flat `MeshBasicMaterial`; gold luminance 0.670 vs bloom threshold 0.7 | hot core + mid band + wide halo | blocker |
| E6 | env | `src/game/world/materials.ts` | No normal/AO/metalness/emissive maps; one flat ivory and one gold across 265 m | normal-mapped trim sheets, edge wear | blocker |
| H1 | hud | `src/game/hud/HUD.tsx` | Behind-camera projection double-flips x and pins y; edge arrow hard-coded pointing up | correct off-screen waypoint arrow | blocker |
| H2 | hud | `src/game/hud/HUD.tsx` | No enemy health, no boss bar; the 0–100 stagger meter is never surfaced | target plate + boss bar + stagger tell | blocker |
| H3 | hud | `src/game/hud/hud.css` | `.hud-dmgvig` is a uniform full-screen flash — no directional hit indicator | directional arc per damage source | blocker |
| H4 | hud | `src/game/hud/HUD.tsx` | Skip hint only renders in DROPSHIP, where `#hud` is `opacity:0`; copy contradicts bindings | visible, accurate prompt | blocker |
| M1 | mission | `src/screens/PauseScreen.tsx` | Nothing gates `useFrame` or zeroes `timeScale` — the mission runs (and can lose) while "PAUSED" | real pause | blocker |
| M2 | mission | `src/game/mission/ObjectiveMarker.tsx` | 3D octahedron + DOM `.obj-marker` both draw the same objective, 2.2 m apart | one occlusion-aware waypoint per objective | blocker |
| P1 | player | `src/game/player/PlayerRig.tsx` | `gaitPhase += speed/strideLength` (missing 2π) → 6.9 m steps; no foot contact at all | contact-locked ~2 m stride | blocker |
| P2 | player | `src/game/player/PlayerRig.tsx` | `body` sits at the capsule bottom, so glide/death/wallrun rotate about the feet | pelvis-pivoted poses | blocker |
| P3 | player | `src/game/player/PlayerRig.tsx` | Wall-run never reads `PlayerRef.wallNormal`: upright figure in air, no contact VFX | feet planted, hand trailing, dust | blocker |
| P4 | player | `src/game/player/PlayerRig.tsx` | `landImpact`/`landTimer` are written and never read — no landing pose at any fall speed | impact-scaled landing to three-point | blocker |
| P5 | player | `src/game/player/PlayerRig.tsx` | Character holds nothing; `ViewModel.tsx` pins the rifle to the camera 2.8 m ahead of it | IK'd two-hand grip, holstered idle | blocker |
| V1 | vfx | `src/game/PostFX.tsx` | Tonemap runs in-material before the composer; nothing outputs >1.0, so bloom thresholds LDR | HDR-authored energy, bloom pre-tonemap | blocker |
| V2 | vfx | `src/game/vfx/Particles.tsx` | No depth fetch anywhere — every particle hard-clips against geometry | depth-faded soft particles | blocker |
| V3 | vfx | `src/game/vfx/Particles.tsx` | One `smoothstep` blob in 3 tints is the only particle shape in the game | spark/smoke/ember/debris sheets | blocker |
| V4 | vfx | `src/game/vfx/Shockwaves.tsx` | No refraction or scene-texture sample anywhere; the ult bends nothing | refraction shell on every pressure wave | blocker |
| V5 | vfx | `src/game/vfx/Trails.tsx` | No UVs; both edge verts share alpha/colour → flat hard-edged paper strip | hot spine, feathered edges, erosion | blocker |

## Ownership boundaries

Strictly disjoint. Any change outside your set is a request to the owner, not an edit.

**environment-art** — `src/game/world/**` (`ShrineStation.tsx`, `layout.ts`, `materials.ts`, `Lighting.tsx`, `Skybox.tsx`, `Fog.tsx`, `EnvironmentFX.tsx`, `Colliders.ts`, `ColliderDebug.tsx`, `index.ts`) and `src/game/textures.ts`.

**player-frame** — `src/game/player/**` (`PlayerRig.tsx`, `PlayerController.tsx`, `CameraRig.tsx`, `PlayerRef.ts`, `movementConfig.ts`, `index.ts`). Owns the `PlayerSockets`/`CamRef` surfaces other streams consume.

**combat-feel** — `src/game/combat/**` (`Weapons.tsx`, `Abilities.tsx`, `ViewModel.tsx`, `DamageSystem.ts`, `state.ts`, `index.tsx`).

**vfx-postfx** — `src/game/vfx/**`, `src/game/PostFX.tsx`, `src/game/GameCanvas.tsx`, `src/game/config.ts`. Owning `config.ts` and the Canvas makes this stream the tuning/pipeline registrar: other streams request constants and mount-order changes here. New sprite atlases go in a new `src/game/vfx/vfxTextures.ts`, not `textures.ts`.

**enemies-hud** — `src/game/enemies/**`, `src/game/mission/**`, `src/game/hud/**` (incl. `hud.css`), `src/screens/**`, `src/App.tsx`.

Cross-stream contracts that must not be broken unilaterally: `PlayerRef`/`PlayerAnim` field names, `CamRef` + `addTrauma`, `VFXBus` verb signatures, `EnemyRegistry.damage()`, `SpawnStatus`, and `layout.ts` coordinates (art and collision both read them).
